It can be talked to prior to the encounter to apply the effect to the fight. Alternatively, the Ominous Wicker Man will apply all four curses at once.

Widow Arak'nai, codenamed the Weaver, is one of the three leaders of the Severed Threads conspiracy, the other two being Anub'azal (the General) and Executor Nizrek (the Vizier). She leads a titular subfaction, the Weaver, and is found dangling from the ceiling in the center of the Weaver's Lair in Azj-Kahet. Linny Leadfinger can be found nearby.
The Widow's Undercrawler is an undercrawler mount that can be purchased for 2,020 Kej from Yamas the Provider or Bobbin in Azj-Kahet after reaching standing with the Weaver.
Wide-Eyed Wonder is a passive racial trait for earthen. It triples the amount of experience gained from discovering new locations.
Wicktor is a mole located in Mourning Rise on the Isle of Dorn. He is Workmaster Earwax's companion.
Whoopy is an owl companion. This is the retail variant of the Classic pet, Swoopy.

The Wild Coast is a section of coastline on the northeastern end of the Waking Shores. It acts as the landing site for the Dragonscale Expedition, who have set up two small camps: one for members of the Alliance and one for members of the Horde. Most NPCs at the two camps are friendly to players of both factions. The area is volcanic and, outside of the Dragonscale Expedition camps, heavily populated by hostile proto-dragons. Marmoni, hornswogs, skitterflies, hares, and salamanthers can also be found here in smaller numbers. Wingrest Bay is located to the northeast. The Restless Wetlands are to the south. Wingrest Embassy is to the southwest. The Scalecracker Peaks and Scalecracker Keep are

Wickerman Ashes are created in front of the Horde's wickerman in the Ruins of Lordaeron and in the Frostwall garrison (Tier 3 only) whenever a Horde player uses the nearby Bonfire to set the wickerman on fire. They grant the buff Grim Visage when interacted with. The Ashes in the Ruins of Lordaeron disappear when an Alliance player douses the wickerman for A Time to Lose, but the Bonfire can be reused at any time to set the wickerman back on fire and create new Ashes.

Wila'ma, a mammoth loa and the Loa of Travelers, is one that lives in the heart of many forest tribes. Without the care of her and her kin, the amani would be like nervous kapara every time they ventured out for hunts, or pilgrimages, or trade between villages.

This gnarled oak staff has a long grip wrapped tightly with thin strips of leather. One end is capped with stone while the other end is twisted with sawed-down branches. The staff allows its wielder to cast a plethora of druid spells, one of them being Barkskin. It was wielded by Malfurion Stormrage.

__NOTOC__ Wild Experimentation is a Khaz Algar Alchemy recipe. Spending 20 of any herb from Khaz Algar along with 2 Coreway Catalysts allows the player to attempt to learn an unlearned alchemy recipe. Only recipes that use the herb as a reagent can be learned. For example, Flask of Tempered Aggression can never be learned by experimenting with Mycobloom because Mycobloom is not one of its reagents. If the cast is unsuccessful, the player takes 99% of their health in damage and is knocked backwards. They also gain a debuff preventing further experimentation for 10 minutes, but this can be removed with Formulated Courage. The likelihood of a successful experiment is increased while a Concoctor
